TIP_AUDIO_FILE_PATH: Full file path of the chosen audio file.
TIP_AUDIO_BROWSE_BTN: Open file browser to pick an audio file (Hotkey: Alt+B).
TIP_AUDIO_CLOUD_BTN: Configure remote stem separation credentials (Hotkey: Alt+A).
TIP_AUDIO_ADV_SHOW: Show advanced audio settings, evasion sliders, and trimmer (Hotkey: Alt+S in this tab).
TIP_AUDIO_PITCH: Shift pitch by semitones to alter melody and chord recognition.
TIP_AUDIO_TEMPO: Modify playback tempo to disrupt fingerprint time alignment.
TIP_AUDIO_JITTER: Applies subtle micro-timing variations (+/-16 ms) across audio frames.
TIP_AUDIO_BODE: Shifts frequencies non-harmonically to disrupt overtone patterns.
TIP_AUDIO_DECOY: Injects subtle acoustic variations into spectrogram energy peaks.
TIP_AUDIO_ALLPASS: Disperses phase and softens sharp transients without changing frequency magnitude.
TIP_AUDIO_REAMPING: Simulates acoustic room reflections and monitor speaker response.
TIP_AUDIO_VOCAL: Attenuates center-channel vocals and applies formant variations.
TIP_AUDIO_PREAMBLE: Prepends subtle lead-in tone crossfaded into the start of the audio.
TIP_AUDIO_FILTERS: Applies high-pass and low-pass EQ filtering to roll off extreme frequencies.
TIP_AUDIO_DITHER: Adds low-level TPDF dither noise to randomize least significant bits.
TIP_AUDIO_METADATA: Strips all ID3 tags, RIFF chunks, and metadata from exported file.
TIP_AUDIO_TRIM_CHK: Trims audio file to specified maximum duration.
TIP_AUDIO_TRIM_SPIN: Maximum duration in seconds to keep from the start of the track.
TIP_AUDIO_PROCESS_BTN: Process the audio file with selected parameters and save output (Hotkey: Alt+P).
TIP_AUDIO_AUDIT_BTN: Run quantitative Chromaprint fingerprint audit (Hotkey: Alt+E).
TIP_AUDIO_SLICER_BTN: Slice audio into safe WAV chunks for Suno Library (Hotkey: Alt+S in this tab).
TIP_AUDIO_PROTOCOL_BTN: View Suno upload guidelines and tips.
TIP_AUDIO_LOG: Log detailing audio processing steps and export status.
TIP_LYRICS_INPUT: Type or paste your original lyrics here.
TIP_LYRICS_CELEB: Replaces names of copyright artists and celebrities with generic tags.
TIP_LYRICS_BLACKLIST_BTN: View and edit the blacklist of celebrity and artist names.
TIP_LYRICS_PROFANITY: Replaces explicit language and slurs with musical, safe words.
TIP_LYRICS_UNICODE: Normalizes accents, smart quotes, dashes, and strips non-printable characters.
TIP_LYRICS_TAGS: Standardizes cues like [Verse], [Chorus], [Drop], [Bridge], [Outro] and fixes brackets.
TIP_LYRICS_LENGTH: Audits line lengths against the recommended 80-char ceiling and 3,000 token limit.
TIP_LYRICS_CLOAK: Transforms lyrics using spelling variations and phonetic substitutions.
TIP_LYRICS_MODE: Select sanitization strategy for lyrics phrasing and vocabulary.
TIP_LYRICS_CLOUD_BTN: Configure Groq, OpenRouter, or OpenAI API credentials.
TIP_LYRICS_VIBRATO: Appends vocal vibrato markers (~) to phrase endings to signal singing inflection.
TIP_LYRICS_SYLLABLE: Ensures rewritten lines maintain the original syllable count.
TIP_LYRICS_NGRAM: Injects subtle musical variations to break repeated phrases.
TIP_LYRICS_PROCESS_BTN: Run moderation filters and lyrics sanitization (Hotkey: Alt+S).
TIP_LYRICS_COPY_BTN: Copy the sanitized output lyrics to system clipboard (Hotkey: Alt+C).
TIP_LYRICS_SAMPLE_BTN: Insert sample test lyrics containing artist names and structure tags.
TIP_LYRICS_CLEAR_BTN: Clear input, output, and report fields.
TIP_LYRICS_OUTPUT: Final sanitized lyrics ready to use.
TIP_LYRICS_CHANGES: Report of moderation changes, syllable counts, and applied variations.
